transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I am constantly being watched and monitored by a specific group of people. They have been tracking my movements and listening to my conversations, and it's getting very hard to deal with. I just need someone to help me make them stop.
Besides feeling watched, have you been hearing voices or having trouble organizing your thoughts or daily activities?

No, I don't hear any voices, and my thoughts are perfectly clear. My daily activities and my ability to function are completely fine; I still go to work and manage my life without any issues. My only concern is the fact that this group is constantly watching and monitoring me.
How long have you been feeling that this group is watching and monitoring you?

It has been going on for about two months now. I first noticed it around the beginning of October, and it has been happening every single day since then. It's really stressful because I can't seem to shake them off no matter what I do.
Have you noticed any major changes like losing motivation, withdrawing from people, or having less emotional expression lately?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. My motivation is still good, and I'm still socializing and expressing myself just like I always have. The only thing that causes me any stress or makes me want to keep to myself sometimes is dealing with this constant monitoring.
Do you feel this group is controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind, or is it mainly that they are watching and listening to you?

No, they aren't controlling my thoughts or putting anything into my head. It is strictly that they are constantly watching, tracking, and listening to everything I do. It just feels like I have absolutely no privacy because of their constant monitoring.
Outside of dealing with this monitoring, has your work performance or your relationships changed in any major way?

No, my work performance and my relationships are still generally normal and haven't changed in any major way. The only difference is the added stress and distraction of trying to manage this constant monitoring. Other than that, I am still doing my job and interacting with people just like I always have.
Before these last two months, had you ever had any similar periods of feeling watched or monitored, even briefly?
No, I have never experienced anything like this before in my life. This is the very first time I have ever felt watched or monitored, and it all began exactly two months ago.
Since this has lasted about two months, has the feeling of being watched been present most days the whole time without going away for long periods?
Yes, it has been happening almost every single day for the past two months without any break. It never really lets up, and the constant feeling of being watched is just exhausting.
Before this started, were there any months when you had milder symptoms like suspiciousness, social withdrawal, or trouble functioning, even if the feeling of being watched was not as strong?

No, I don't recall having any of those milder symptoms, social withdrawal, or functioning issues before this started. Everything was completely normal for me until two months ago. I didn't experience anything like that beforehand.
Is there any part of you that thinks this could be a misunderstanding, or are you completely certain this group is truly monitoring you?

There is absolutely no misunderstanding about this, and I am one hundred percent certain that they are monitoring me. I know exactly what I am experiencing, and it is completely real. I just need you to believe me so we can focus on how to make them stop.
